# Vendored browser assets (generated, do not edit by hand)

Built by `npm run build:vendor` from pinned npm packages in `package.json`/`package-lock.json`:

- htmx.org 2.0.11 (Zero-Clause BSD): `vendor/js/htmx.min.js`
- chart.js 4.6.1 (MIT): `vendor/js/chart.umd.min.js`
- Inter Variable 5.3.0 (SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/INTER-OFL.txt`): `fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2`
- JetBrains Mono Variable 5.3.0 (SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/JETBRAINS-MONO-OFL.txt`): `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2`
- Lucide icons 1.66.0 (ISC, see `icons/LUCIDE-ISC.txt`): `icons/*.svg` (18-icon subset)

No CDN or remote fetch is used at runtime; every browser asset is served from this server.
